description: This file contains the implementation of the Category class in the Opencart.Catalog.Model.Catalog namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve category information, related filters, layout IDs, and other category-specific data for the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: A model class for interacting with categories in the OpenCart catalog, providing methods to fetch category data, filters, and layout IDs.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific category based on its ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches a list of categories that have a specified parent ID.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Gets filter options associated with a specific category.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout ID assigned to a specific category.
